ActivateBody.description:
Body of ``POST /{strategy_id}/activate`` (contract ActivateRequest).

``mode`` is accepted as text so AUTO_LIVE gets an explicit
TRADE_MODE_DISABLED explanation instead of a generic schema error.

Attributes:
    version: Version to activate.
    mode: ``ALERT_ONLY``, ``PAPER`` or ``SHADOW``.
    instruments: Optional explicit instruments.
ActivateBody.title: ActivateBody

AlertJob.description:
Persistent Python alert evaluation state and visible diagnostics.

Attributes:
    job_id: Opaque tenant-owned alert identifier.
    created_at_ms: Creation time in UTC epoch milliseconds.
    last_processed_ms: Latest successfully evaluated bar close/checkpoint.
    last_error: Visible missing-data, provider or user-code failure, if any.
    last_checked_ms: Last evaluation attempt in UTC epoch milliseconds.
    emitted: Number of distinct conditions recorded for this job.
    source_hash: Source identity pinned at save; a catalog script whose
        installed source changed is not evaluated until saved again.
    title: Display name of the condition script at save.
AlertJob.title: AlertJob

AlertJobInput.description:
Explicitly enables a pinned Python condition on future closed bars.

Attributes:
    script_id: Owned alert, indicator or strategy script publishing
        conditions.
    version: Positive immutable tenant version, pinned rather than
        following edits; 0 for a built-in or plugin script, whose
        installed source hash is pinned instead.
    instrument_id: Canonical instrument whose new closed bars are evaluated.
    tf: Source resolution, one second through one calendar month.
    inputs: JSON values overriding the pinned version's defaults.
    subscription_ids: Explicit owned notification destinations; UI is
        implicit.
    enabled: Whether evaluation and external notification routing are
        active.
    history_bars: Context depth, two through two thousand closed bars.
AlertJobInput.title: AlertJobInput

AllNode.description:
TRUE when every child is TRUE (Kleene conjunction).

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``ALL``.
    id: Stable editor id echoed in the reason tree.
    label: Optional display label.
    children: 1-32 child nodes.
AllNode.title: AllNode

AnyNode.description:
TRUE when any child is TRUE (Kleene disjunction).

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``ANY``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    children: 1-32 child nodes.
AnyNode.title: AnyNode

AoiOverlapNode.description:
Two live AOIs of different kind sets overlap.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``AOI_OVERLAP``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    kinds_a: First kind set.
    kinds_b: Second kind set.
    side: Required side for both AOIs.
    tf: Detection timeframe (defaults to the signal timeframe).
    min_overlap_pct: Minimum overlap as percent of the smaller zone.
AoiOverlapNode.title: AoiOverlapNode

AoiTouchNode.description:
A recent closed bar touched a previously confirmed AOI.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``AOI_TOUCH``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    kinds: Acceptable AOI kinds.
    side: Required AOI side.
    tf: AOI detection timeframe (defaults to the signal timeframe).
    within_bars: Lookback in closed signal bars (0 = current bar).
    touch: Intersection rule.
    require_active: AOI must still be live at evaluation time.
    min_quality: Minimum plugin quality score.
AoiTouchNode.title: AoiTouchNode

BacktestBody.description:
Body mirroring the contract ``BacktestRequest``.

Unknown fields are rejected (422).

Attributes:
    version: Strategy version number to evaluate.
    instrument_id: Canonical instrument id.
    from_ms: Inclusive start, UTC epoch milliseconds.
    to_ms: Exclusive end, UTC epoch milliseconds.
    fee_bps: Fee per side in basis points; when omitted, the
        strategy's fee estimate or 0.
    slippage_bps: Slippage on market fills in basis points; the
        runner's default when omitted.
    max_hold_bars: Bars before a timeout exit (1..10000); the runner's
        default when omitted.
BacktestBody.title: BacktestBody

CandleOperand.description:
Signal-candle field operand.

Attributes:
    kind: Discriminator ``candle``.
    tf: Candle timeframe (signal timeframe only in this version).
    field: OHLCV field.
    bars_ago: Offset in closed signal bars.
CandleOperand.title: CandleOperand

CatalogInput.description:
A declared input of a built-in or plugin script.

Attributes:
    default: JSON default value.
    title: Settings label.
    minimum: Optional inclusive numeric lower bound.
    maximum: Optional inclusive numeric upper bound.
    options: Optional accepted values.
    step: Optional numeric step.
    group: Optional settings section.
    tooltip: Optional help text.
CatalogInput.title: CatalogInput

CatalogList.description:
Installed built-in and plugin scripts and skipped plugin packages.

Attributes:
    scripts: Scripts in catalog order.
    failures: Plugin entry points that failed to load, with reasons.
CatalogList.title: CatalogList

CatalogScript.description:
A built-in or installed plugin script that the engine runs in process.

Attributes:
    script_id: ``builtin:<id>`` or ``plugin:<entry point>:<id>``.
    kind: indicator, strategy, library, filter or alert.
    origin: builtin or plugin.
    package: Providing distribution of a plugin.
    package_version: That distribution's version.
    title: Display name.
    short_title: Compact legend name.
    description: Catalog description.
    category: Catalog section.
    overlay: Whether plots share the price pane.
    inputs: Declared inputs in display order.
    requests: Declared additional series by alias.
    source_available: Whether the public source can be read.
    source_hash: Identity of the installed code.
    enabled: False when disabled by configuration.
    source: Public source text on the single-script route, else None.
    metrics: Market data a filter loads beyond the snapshot.
CatalogScript.title: CatalogScript

CompareNode.description:
Binary comparison of two operands.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``COMPARE``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    left: Left operand.
    cmp: Comparator.
    right: Right operand.
CompareNode.title: CompareNode

ConnectionGrant.description:
A newly issued connection credential shown once.

A newly issued connection credential shown once to its authenticated owner.

Attributes:
    connection_id: Opaque revocation identifier.
    url: Public MCP endpoint URL to configure in the client.
    token: Secret resource-bound bearer credential, returned only at
        creation.
    scopes: Explicit read/write/trade permissions.
    expires_at: Expiration as UTC epoch seconds.
ConnectionGrant.title: ConnectionGrant

ConnectionInput.description:
An explicit user-created MCP automation permission grant.

Attributes:
    name: Human-readable connection name, maximum one hundred twenty chars.
    write: Allow changes to private user data and notification destinations.
    trade: Allow trading operations in addition to all existing broker
        gates.
    lifetime_s: Lifetime in seconds, one minute through thirty days.
ConnectionInput.title: ConnectionInput

ConstOperand.description:
Constant decimal operand.

Attributes:
    kind: Discriminator ``const``.
    value: The constant.
ConstOperand.title: ConstOperand

CrossesNode.description:
``left`` crossed ``right`` between the previous and current bar.

``ABOVE``: at or below on the previous bar, above on the current one;
``BELOW`` mirrors it.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``CROSSES``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    left: Moving operand.
    right: Reference operand.
    direction: ``ABOVE`` or ``BELOW``.
CrossesNode.title: CrossesNode

DataPolicy.description:
Input freshness policy.

Attributes:
    max_data_age_ms: Maximum time from the evaluated bar's close to the
        evaluation; an older bar evaluates to UNKNOWN.
    allow_rest_poll: Whether polled (POLL) candles are acceptable.
DataPolicy.title: DataPolicy

EventNode.description:
An indicator event confirmed within the lookback.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``EVENT``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    name: Event name.
    source: Plugin that must publish the event; any plugin's events of
        that name count when omitted.
    tf: Event timeframe (defaults to the signal timeframe).
    within_bars: Lookback in closed signal bars (0 = current bar).
EventNode.title: EventNode

EventRef.description:
Reference to an indicator event on a timeframe.

Attributes:
    name: Event name.
    source: Plugin that must publish the event; any plugin's events of
        that name count when omitted.
    tf: Event timeframe (defaults to the signal timeframe).
EventRef.title: EventRef

HeatmapCatalog.description:
Every data set and the default per heatmap family.

Attributes:
    datasets: Data sets in menu order.
    defaults: Default data set id per heatmap family.
HeatmapCatalog.title: HeatmapCatalog

HeatmapDataset.description:
A selectable data set (an index, a market or a coin universe).

Attributes:
    id: Stable id, e.g. ``us_sp500`` or ``crypto_all``.
    type: Heatmap family.
    label: Human label, e.g. ``S&P 500``.
    section: Menu section, e.g. ``United States``, ``Taiwan``, ``Crypto``.
    currency: Quote currency of prices and sizes (``USD`` or ``TWD``).
    default_limit: Tiles shown by default (the largest first).
    available: Whether the configured sources can serve it.
    reason: Why it is unavailable, or None.
HeatmapDataset.title: HeatmapDataset

HeatmapGrouping.description:
A grouping option of the selected data set.

Attributes:
    id: ``sector``, ``asset_class`` or ``none``.
    label: Human label, e.g. ``Sector``.
    available: Whether tiles carry this grouping.
    reason: Why the grouping is unavailable, or None.
HeatmapGrouping.title: HeatmapGrouping

HeatmapMetric.description:
One size or colour metric and whether the source supplies it.

Attributes:
    id: Stable metric id, e.g. ``market_cap`` or ``change_1d``.
    label: Human label, e.g. ``Change 1D, %``.
    format: Value format: currency amount, percent, plain number or
        ratio (relative volume).
    scale: Colour scale of a colour metric: ``diverging`` (red/grey/green)
        or ``sequential`` (single-hue intensity); None for size metrics.
    available: Whether at least the source can supply the metric.
    reason: Why the metric is unavailable, or None when available.
HeatmapMetric.title: HeatmapMetric

HeatmapProvenance.description:
Where one part of the heatmap comes from.

Attributes:
    field: What the source supplies, e.g. ``Sector & market cap``.
    source: Source label, e.g. ``Nasdaq.com screener (unofficial,
        delayed)``.
    as_of_ms: When the source data was fetched or observed, UTC epoch
        milliseconds, or None when it is not loaded yet.
    note: Optional caveat such as ``derived: shares x last price``.
HeatmapProvenance.title: HeatmapProvenance

HeatmapSnapshot.description:
A heatmap of one data set with metric availability and provenance.

Attributes:
    type: Heatmap family.
    dataset: Data set id.
    dataset_label: Data set label.
    currency: Currency of prices and currency-valued metrics.
    tiles: Tiles, largest default size first.
    universe_count: Members of the data set before the limit.
    limit: Requested maximum tiles.
    priced_count: Tiles with a price.
    size_metrics: Size-by options with availability.
    color_metrics: Colour-by options with availability.
    groupings: Group-by options with availability.
    default_size: Default size metric id.
    default_color: Default colour metric id.
    default_grouping: Default grouping id.
    provenance: Source of each part of the data.
    source_errors: Per-source failures limiting the result.
    pending: True while a slow source is still loading; the client
        should poll again soon for fuller coverage.
    generated_at_ms: Response time, UTC epoch milliseconds.
    demo: True for synthetic DEMO data.
HeatmapSnapshot.title: HeatmapSnapshot

HeatmapTile.description:
One symbol of the map.

Attributes:
    key: Unique key within the data set (ticker or coin id).
    symbol: Display ticker.
    name: Company, fund or coin name, or None.
    group: Sector (stocks), asset class (ETFs) or None (crypto).
    industry: Industry within the sector, or None.
    exchange: Listing exchange, or None.
    instrument_id: Canonical instrument to chart, or None when no
        configured venue lists it.
    chart_unavailable_reason: Why no chart can open, or None.
    price: Last price as a decimal string, or None.
    metrics: Available metric values by metric id (decimal strings);
        a missing key means the value is unavailable for this symbol.
    as_of_ms: Quote observation or fetch time, or None.
    error: Per-symbol source problem, or None.
HeatmapTile.title: HeatmapTile

InRangeNode.description:
Operand inside ``[low, high]`` (or open interval when exclusive).

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``IN_RANGE``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    value: Tested operand.
    low: Lower bound operand.
    high: Upper bound operand.
    inclusive: Whether bounds are inclusive.
InRangeNode.title: InRangeNode

InZoneNode.description:
Price inside a live AOI of the given kinds on ``tf``.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``IN_ZONE``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    kinds: Acceptable AOI kinds.
    side: Required AOI side, if any.
    tf: AOI detection timeframe.
    price_source: Candle price compared with the zone.
    group: Nodes sharing a group must agree on the AOI ``group_id``.
InZoneNode.title: InZoneNode

IndicatorOperand.description:
Published indicator value operand.

Attributes:
    kind: Discriminator ``indicator``.
    plugin_id: Producing plugin.
    tf: Series timeframe (defaults to the signal timeframe).
    field: Published value key.
    bars_ago: Offset in closed signal bars.
IndicatorOperand.title: IndicatorOperand

LibraryRef.description:
Pins one reusable library to an immutable tenant-owned version.

Attributes:
    script_id: Tenant-local library slug.
    version: Positive immutable version number; never resolves latest.
LibraryRef.title: LibraryRef

LocalTimeWindow.description:
Local-time window ``[start, end)``; ``end <= start`` wraps midnight.

Attributes:
    start: Inclusive start ``HH:MM``.
    end: Exclusive end ``HH:MM``.
LocalTimeWindow.title: LocalTimeWindow

MarketOperand.description:
Market context operand (funding, open interest, spread, turnover).

Attributes:
    kind: Discriminator ``market``.
    field: Market field.
MarketOperand.title: MarketOperand

MarketType.description:
Product type at a venue (contract ``MarketType``).

``stock`` and ``etf`` are exchange-listed cash securities; ``rate`` is a
published, non-tradable rate series such as a Treasury par yield.
MarketType.title: MarketType

NotNode.description:
Kleene negation of one child.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``NOT``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    child: Negated node.
NotNode.title: NotNode

NotificationPolicy.description:
Notification and de-duplication policy.

Attributes:
    cooldown_bars: Bars after a fired entry during which new entries
        on the same instrument/direction are blocked.
    once_per_aoi: Fire at most once per AOI.
    emit: Signal kinds the user wants to receive.
    channels: Notification channels allowed for this strategy.
NotificationPolicy.title: NotificationPolicy

PersistForNode.description:
Child TRUE on each of the last ``bars`` closed bars.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``PERSIST_FOR``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    bars: Number of consecutive bars.
    child: Persisting node.
PersistForNode.title: PersistForNode

PlotPoint.description:
One script-produced scalar at a closed bar.

Attributes:
    time_ms: Bar start in UTC epoch milliseconds.
    value: Finite numeric output, or None during warm-up.
    color: Optional literal per-bar hex color for conditional plot coloring.
PlotPoint.title: PlotPoint

PlotSeries.description:
Named output series displayed by the terminal.

Attributes:
    name: Public series name, one to sixty-four characters.
    points: At most two thousand chronological closed-bar values.
PlotSeries.title: PlotSeries

RevalidateBody.description:
Optional body of ``POST /{strategy_id}/validate``.

Attributes:
    version: Version to re-validate (latest when omitted).
RevalidateBody.title: RevalidateBody

RiskModel.description:
Stop, target and minimum reward/risk policy.

Attributes:
    min_rr: Strategy-level floor for net reward/risk on every entry.
    stop_model: How the protective stop is placed.
    stop_buffer_atr: Stop buffer in ATR(14) multiples.
    target_model: How the target is placed.
    target_kinds: AOI kinds ``NEAREST_AOI`` may target.
    fixed_r: Reward multiple for ``FIXED_R`` targets.
    fee_bps_estimate: Estimated cost per side in basis points.
    max_risk_pct_equity: Sizing hint for the execution engine.
RiskModel.title: RiskModel

RiskRewardNode.description:
Projected net reward/risk is at least ``min_rr``.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``RISK_REWARD``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    min_rr: Minimum net reward/risk.
RiskRewardNode.title: RiskRewardNode

ScanCondition.description:
One filter of a composed scan; an instrument must match every one.

Attributes:
    script_id: Owned Filter slug, ``builtin:<id>`` or a plugin id.
    version: Tenant version, latest when omitted; catalog scripts pin
        their installed source hash instead.
    inputs: JSON values overriding the filter's defaults.
ScanCondition.title: ScanCondition

ScanConditionPin.description:
A scan condition resolved and pinned at submission.

Attributes:
    script_id: Filter identifier.
    version: Tenant version, or 0 for a catalog script.
    source_hash: Exact source identity evaluated.
    title: Display name of the filter.
    inputs: Effective inputs (defaults plus overrides).
ScanConditionPin.title: ScanConditionPin

ScanInput.description:
Selects a real market universe for an isolated Python filter job.

Attributes:
    version: Optional immutable filter version; defaults to the latest.
    venue: Exchange/market venue to scan, or all enabled venues.
    market_type: Optional instrument market category, such as stock or perp.
    query: Optional symbol/name search within that market.
    max_symbols: Explicit maximum instruments, one through ten thousand.
    history_bars: Closed bars per instrument; zero uses snapshots only.
    tf: Resolution used when historical bars are requested.
    inputs: JSON values overriding the pinned filter's defaults.
    conditions: Further filters an instrument must also match (AND);
        the only filters of a scan submitted without a path script.
    metrics: Data to load beyond the snapshot; catalog filters add the
        metrics they declare.
    order_by: "symbol" scans instruments by id; "turnover" loads every
        quote first and scans the highest 24h turnover first, so
        max_symbols keeps the most active instruments.
ScanInput.title: ScanInput

ScanJob.description:
Progress and reproducible results for an asynchronous market scan.

Attributes:
    job_id: Opaque tenant-owned scan identifier.
    script_id: Filter script slug.
    version: Immutable filter version pinned at submission.
    status: Pending, running, complete, failed or cancelled job state.
    created_at_ms: Submission time, UTC epoch milliseconds.
    total: Number of eligible instruments selected by the explicit scan
        bound.
    scanned: Instruments evaluated or reported unavailable so far.
    matches: Matching instrument records with real source snapshots.
    errors: Per-instrument filter failures (script errors).
    error: Job-level error, otherwise None.
    source_hash: Immutable source/dependency configuration hash.
    universe_count: Total eligible market instruments before max_symbols.
    conditions: Every pinned filter, in evaluation order; the first is
        also described by script_id, version and source_hash.
    unavailable: Instruments without the data a filter needs (missing
        quote, history or metric), with the reason; never matches.
ScanJob.title: ScanJob

ScriptAlertEvent.description:
One user-authored alert condition matched on a source bar.

Attributes:
    name: Stable condition name used for per-bar delivery deduplication.
    message: Plain-text message, at most five hundred characters.
    time_ms: Source bar start, UTC epoch milliseconds.
    severity: Notification priority used by delivery filters and quiet
        hours.
ScriptAlertEvent.title: ScriptAlertEvent

ScriptInput.description:
Creates an immutable script version with explicit type and dependencies.

Attributes:
    script_id: Stable tenant-local slug; must match the path on updates.
    kind: One of the five script roles; immutable after creation.
    name: Display title, one to one hundred twenty characters.
    source: UTF-8 Python source, at most sixty-four KiB.
    overlay: Whether indicator/strategy plots share the main price pane.
    defaults: Default JSON input values overridden by an individual run.
    libraries: Python import aliases mapped to pinned library versions.
    expected_version: Optimistic lock for edits; required for a new version.
    requests: Up to four declared cross-symbol/timeframe source aliases.
ScriptInput.title: ScriptInput

ScriptList.description:
An owned script catalog and its execution availability.

Attributes:
    scripts: Latest visible scripts or requested immutable version history.
    runtime_enabled: Whether an isolated runtime has been enabled by
        operator.
    next_offset: Next bounded catalog window, or None at the end.
ScriptList.title: ScriptList

ScriptResult.description:
Reproducible plots and optional simulated strategy performance.

Attributes:
    script_id: Tenant-owned script slug.
    version: Immutable script version evaluated.
    kind: Indicator, strategy, filter or alert; libraries are import-only.
    source_hash: Content hash including default inputs and dependency pins.
    instrument_id: Canonical source instrument identifier.
    tf: Source bar resolution.
    bars_count: Number of source bars evaluated, including provisional bars
        only when explicitly requested for an indicator.
    feed_state: Source provenance; DEMO data remains explicitly marked.
    data_source: Upstream provider provenance label.
    complete: Whether the requested history has no closed-bar gaps.
    overlay: Whether plots share the main price pane.
    plots: At most sixty-four scalar output series.
    fills: Simulated next-bar-open fills; empty for indicators.
    equity_curve: Marked simulated quote equity; empty for indicators.
    metrics: Finite numeric simulation statistics, including fees and
        unfilled final-bar intents; no performance is fabricated.
    matched: Boolean decision for a filter, otherwise None.
    alerts: Previewed alert events; delivery requires an enabled alert job.
    visuals: Bounded declarative drawings, fills, coloring and tables.
    bar_closes: Confirmed source bar starts mapped to actual evaluated
        closes;
        alert checkpoints never consult a later, different market window.
    plot_styles: Per-series input/style settings used by the renderer.
    bar_visuals: Per-bar colors, symbols and custom OHLC series, separately
        bounded from persistent drawing objects.
ScriptResult.title: ScriptResult

ScriptRun.description:
Requests a reproducible run using closed, real backend candles.

Attributes:
    version: Pinned script version, or latest when omitted.
    instrument_id: Canonical venue:market:symbol identifier.
    tf: Supported chart timeframe, one second through one calendar month.
    limit: Maximum closed bars, from two through two thousand.
    from_ms: Optional inclusive UTC epoch millisecond lower boundary.
    to_ms: Optional exclusive UTC epoch millisecond visibility boundary.
    include_open: Evaluate the provisional last bar for indicators only;
        alerts and simulated orders always require closed bars.
    inputs: JSON input values overriding the version's defaults.
    initial_equity: Positive initial simulated cash in quote units.
    commission_bps: Commission in basis points per simulated fill.
    slippage_bps: Adverse simulated slippage in basis points per fill.
ScriptRun.title: ScriptRun

ScriptVersion.description:
A tenant-visible immutable, content-addressed script version.

Attributes:
    version: Positive monotonically increasing version number.
    source_hash: SHA-256 of the source and dependency/input configuration.
    created_at_ms: Creation time in UTC epoch milliseconds.
ScriptVersion.title: ScriptVersion

ScriptVisual.description:
A bounded declarative drawing; never executable browser code.

Attributes:
    id: Stable visual id unique within this script instance.
    kind: Plot/drawing category interpreted by the chart renderer.
    data: JSON coordinates, text and presentation; renderers read only
        documented fields and never inject HTML, CSS URLs or JavaScript.
ScriptVisual.title: ScriptVisual

SequenceNode.description:
Ordered events on distinct bars ending on the evaluated bar.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``SEQUENCE``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    within_bars: Window length in bars, including the evaluated bar.
    steps: 2-8 ordered event references.
SequenceNode.title: SequenceNode

SeriesRequest.description:
Declares another symbol/resolution before isolated indicator execution.

Attributes:
    instrument_id: Optional canonical symbol; defaults to the chart symbol.
    tf: Requested resolution, with confirmed-bar visibility enforced by
        host.
    limit: Maximum closed source bars, one through five hundred.
SeriesRequest.title: SeriesRequest

SetupPolicy.description:
Setup lifetime policy.

Attributes:
    expire_after_bars: Bars after which an unfired setup expires.
SetupPolicy.title: SetupPolicy

SimulatedFill.description:
An isolated strategy simulation fill, never an executable broker order.

Attributes:
    time_ms: Fill bar start in UTC epoch milliseconds.
    side: Buy or sell after converting the signed position target.
    quantity: Positive base-asset quantity filled.
    price: Fill price including adverse slippage, in quote/base units.
    fee: Nonnegative commission in quote units.
    effect: Entry, exit or reversal for unambiguous chart trade markers.
SimulatedFill.title: SimulatedFill

StateNode.description:
Published indicator state on one or more timeframes.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``STATE``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    plugin_id: Plugin whose latest warm snapshot is read.
    timeframes: Timeframes checked.
    where: Clauses that must all match on a timeframe.
    match: ``ALL`` or ``K_OF_N``.
    k: Threshold for ``K_OF_N``.
StateNode.title: StateNode

StrategyDefinition.description:
User-authored strategy (Rule AST v2).

Attributes:
    schema_version: Always 2.
    strategy_id: Slug unique per tenant.
    name: Display name.
    description: Optional description.
    direction: ``LONG`` or ``SHORT``.
    signal_timeframe: Timeframe whose closed bars trigger evaluation.
    universe: Instrument universe.
    when: Root rule node.
    risk: Risk model.
    notification: Notification policy.
    setup: Setup policy.
    data_policy: Freshness policy.
    execution_mode: Requested mode (AUTO_LIVE additionally needs an
        execution-engine deployment with consent).
StrategyDefinition.title: StrategyDefinition

TerminalAction.description:
One explicit operation on a connected, user-enabled browser.

Attributes:
    operation: Registered command, validated workspace replacement, drawing
        edit, replay, theme, export or screenshot operation.
    command_id: Exact registered command id, required for command
        operations.
    arguments: JSON arguments for the selected operation, never source code.
TerminalAction.title: TerminalAction

TimeWindowNode.description:
Evaluated bar starts inside a local-time window.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``TIME_WINDOW``.
    id: Stable editor id.
    label: Optional display label.
    time_zone: IANA time zone of the windows.
    windows: Accepted windows.
    weekdays: Accepted ISO local weekdays (1 = Monday); every day when
        omitted.
TimeWindowNode.title: TimeWindowNode

Universe.description:
Instruments a strategy may evaluate.

Attributes:
    qualification: ``QUALIFIED_ONLY`` or ``ANY``.
    venues: Allowed venues.
    whitelist: If non-empty, only these instruments.
    blacklist: Excluded instruments.
    min_qualified_minutes: Minimum continuous qualification time.
Universe.title: Universe

ValueMatch.description:
One STATE clause: a published value equals one of ``any_of``.

Values compare with the same JSON type, so a string never equals a
boolean.

Attributes:
    field: Published value key.
    any_of: Accepted values.
ValueMatch.title: ValueMatch

WithinBarsNode.description:
Child TRUE on at least one of the last ``bars`` + 1 bars.

Attributes:
    op: Discriminator ``WITHIN_BARS``.

get.description:
Returns areas of interest (AOIs) and recent events.

Args:
    instrument_id: Canonical instrument id.
    tf: Timeframe value, such as ``1h``.
    plugin_set: Query ``set``: comma-separated plugin ids; all
        plugins compatible with this chart and their default
        settings when absent.
    at_ms: Point in time, UTC epoch milliseconds; the latest closed
        bar when absent.
    settings: JSON object mapping plugin ids to setting overrides.

Returns:
    Contract ``AoiList``.

Raises:
    errors.ValidationFailedError: If a parameter or a setting
        override is invalid (422).
    errors.MissingDataError: If no closed candle is available (422).

schema.title: Response Get Aois V1 Aois Get

get.description:
Lists the trading sessions of a calendar in a window.

The window ``[from_ms, to_ms)`` may span at most 400 days. A 24x7
calendar never closes and returns no sessions.

Args:
    calendar_id: Contract ``CalendarId`` (``24x7``, ``XTAI``,
        ``XNYS``, ``USBOND``).
    from_ms: Inclusive window start, UTC epoch milliseconds.
    to_ms: Exclusive window end, UTC epoch milliseconds.

Returns:
    Contract ``SessionList``.

Raises:
    errors.NotFoundError: For an unknown calendar (404).
    errors.ValidationFailedError: For an empty or too long window
        (422).

schema.title: Response Calendar Sessions V1 Calendars  Calendar Id  Sessions Get

get.description:
Returns historical candles with provenance and gaps.

Args:
    instrument_id: Canonical instrument id.
    tf: Timeframe value, such as ``1h``.
    from_ms: Inclusive start, UTC epoch milliseconds.
    to_ms: Exclusive end, UTC epoch milliseconds.
    limit: Maximum bars (default 500, max 5000).
    feed_mode: Contract ``FeedMode`` (``AUTO`` when absent);
        ``REPLAY`` reads recordings, the other modes the venue.

Returns:
    Contract ``CandleBatch``.

Raises:
    errors.ValidationFailedError: On an invalid id, timeframe,
        range, limit or ``feed_mode`` (422).
    errors.NotFoundError: If the venue is not enabled (404).
    errors.MissingDataError: For ``REPLAY`` without a replay source
        (422).

    dataset: Data set id of that family, default its preferred one.
    limit: Maximum tiles, default the data set's own size.

Returns:
    Tiles, metric availability, coverage and provenance.

Args:
    principal: Authenticated caller.

Returns:
